definitions.gloss: boaster; braggart; teller of tall tales
definitions.explanation: A person who habitually exaggerates or tells grand lies. The tone is often playful or critical rather than accusatory.

examples.japanese: ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ほら{吹|ふ}きだ。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、ほら{吹|ふ}きだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{信|しん}じない→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: His stories are interesting, but he's a teller of tall tales so you'd better not believe them.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、「ほら{吹|ふ}き⟦{男爵|だんしゃく}→男爵：13585_danshaku⟧」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧だった。
examples.english: When I was a child, I loved the story of Baron Munchausen.

notes:
USAGE:
Derived from ⟦ほら→ほら：06912_hora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ (to blow a conch shell horn → to boast/brag). The word ⟦ほら→ほら：06912_hora⟧ originally referred to the conch shell ({法螺|ほら}) blown by mountain monks. The image of making a big loud noise evolved into meaning exaggeration and boasting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ほら→ほら：06912_hora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ (to boast, to tell tall tales)
- ほら{吹|ふ}き⟦{男爵|だんしゃく}→男爵：13585_danshaku⟧ (Baron Munchausen)
- {大|おお}ほら{吹|ふ}き (a great braggart)
